title: Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor Critic for Decentralized LLM Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2610.35398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work has explored optimizing LLM collaboration through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), but many approaches still rely on predefined workflows, limiting efficiency and scalability. Decentralized LLM collaboration is challenging because agents execute independently with limited communication, share a joint objective, and must infer useful information from communication traces. In this paper, we propose BCMAAC, a Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor-Critic method that maintains beliefs over contextual information and uses them to facilitate training. Experiments on Minecraft game-playing, web searching and tool-using tasks show that BCMAAC improves task performance and collaborative behavior compared to naive actor-critic baselines. The improvements are particularly pronounced in multi-turn tasks with richer contextual information, where belief modeling provides a clear advantage.

translated_title: 面向去中心化大语言模型协作的信念条件化多智能体Actor-Critic方法
translated_abstract: 近期的研究探索了通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）来优化大语言模型（LLM）协作，但许多方法仍然依赖预定义的工作流程，限制了效率和可扩展性。去中心化的LLM协作极具挑战性，因为智能体需要在有限的通信条件下独立执行任务、共享联合目标，并且必须从通信轨迹中推断有用的信息。在本文中，我们提出了BCMAAC，这是一种信念条件化的多智能体Actor-Critic方法，它通过维护对上下文信息的信念来促进训练。在Minecraft游戏、网络搜索和工具使用任务上的实验表明，与朴素的actor-critic基线相比，BCMAAC提升了任务性能和协作行为。在具有更丰富上下文信息的多轮任务中，改进效果尤为显著，信念建模在其中提供了明显的优势。
tldr: 提出了BCMAAC，一种信念条件化的多智能体Actor-Critic方法，通过维护对上下文信息的信念来促进去中心化LLM协作的训练，在多轮任务中显著提升了任务性能和协作行为。
en_tdlr: We propose BCMAAC, a Belief-Conditioned Multi-Agent Actor-Critic method that maintains beliefs over contextual information to facilitate training for decentralized LLM collaboration, significantly improving task performance and collaborative behavior, especially in multi-turn tasks with richer contextual information.
